title: AWKUM Announces Hostel Admissions 2026 — Applications Open
labels: Notification From Office of The Provost
text:
University News

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM)

AWKUM Announces Hostel Admissions 2026 — Applications Open August 28 to September 1

Office:
Office of the Provost

Notification No.:
AWKUM/PROVOST/2026/1708

Dated:
August 27, 2026

The Office of the Provost, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan, has notified all concerned that
hostel admissions for the 2026 session are now open
. Provisionally selected students are required to submit their hostel admission forms along with the required documents within the specified window at the designated venues for male and female applicants.

Admissions Open

Friday, August 28, 2026

Admissions Close

Tuesday, September 1, 2026

Admission Venues

Hostel admission submissions will be accepted separately for male and female students at the following venues:

Male Students

Provost Office, Garden Campus

Female Students

Office of the Deputy Provost (Female), Main Campus

Required Documents for Submission

Student's CNIC

Father's / Guardian's CNIC

Domicile certificate

One recent passport-size photograph

CNIC of visitors (i.e., next of kin)

Affidavit for admission

Hostel admission form recommended by the Chairman / Principal of the concerned Department / College

Provisionally selected students must submit their admission form in hard copy along with attested photocopies of the above documents.

Important Notes

Please Read Carefully

Afghan nationals are directed to provide evidence of their legal residential status in Pakistan.

Disabled students are required to provide medical evidence of their disability, countersigned by the University Medical Officer.

Old students must clear all outstanding dues prior to their admission.

For any query:
Please contact the Provost Office, Garden Campus.

Official Notification

For complete details, please refer to the official notification issued by the Office of the Provost.
